# Feature Quality Checklist: Phase 0 - Proof of Concept

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md before implementation begins
**Created**: 2026-03-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items test the quality of the requirements themselves, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all screen states (title, opponent selection, game board, game over) fully specified with their visual layout and content requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 through §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are all board cell states (empty, hover, X placed, O placed, winning highlight, disabled) documented with distinct visual requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007 through §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are game over quote requirements specified for all outcome-opponent combinations (human wins/cpu wins/draw x 3 opponents + HvH)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the nine Dune location names and their fixed grid positions documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are all three CPU opponent characters fully specified with name, difficulty level, personality description, and speaking style? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004 through §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are commentary display requirements specified, including when it appears, where it is positioned, and how long it persists? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are "Play Again" and "Rematch" behaviors explicitly defined for both HvH and HvCPU modes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "brief visual feedback" for invalid clicks (FR-033) quantified with a specific duration or animation description? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "visible loading state" (FR-012) specified with concrete visual elements (e.g., text change, opacity, cursor style)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the "visual difficulty indicator (1-3 spice icons)" on opponent cards specified with enough detail for consistent implementation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "styled dialogue area" for commentary (FR-020) defined with positioning, sizing, and visual treatment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "Dune-themed typography" (FR-001) specified with font choices, sizes, and weights, or does it rely on external documents? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "cinematic dark background" (FR-001) defined with specific color values or token references? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "animate the CPU piece placement" (FR-021) specified with animation type and duration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Are FR-012 ("board non-interactive during CPU thinking with visible loading state") and FR-034 ("prevent all board interaction during CPU's turn") intentionally separate or redundantly overlapping? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are win/draw detection requirements (FR-015 for HvH, FR-022 for HvCPU) consistently specified across both modes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are the fallback behaviors in FR-027 (invalid move) and FR-031 (backend failure) distinct and non-conflicting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the term "backend service" used consistently across spec, or are synonyms ("API", "server", "LLM service") used interchangeably? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are turn indicator text requirements consistent between HvH mode ("Player X's turn") and HvCPU mode (character name vs generic label)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 - Can SC-003 ("noticeably different skill levels") be objectively measured, or does it require subjective judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 - Can SC-004 ("stays in character") be objectively verified without subjective interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 - Can SC-006 ("evokes the cinematic Dune aesthetic") be evaluated against concrete, measurable criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is SC-005 ("under 3 seconds") measured from the moment the human clicks to the moment the CPU piece appears, or to when commentary appears? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are acceptance scenarios in all four user stories testable without ambiguity about expected visual outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §US1-US4]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Are all screen transition paths specified (title→board, title→opponent-select→board, board→game-over, game-over→title, game-over→board)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §FR-016, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the flow defined for when a player selects "Human vs CPU" but then wants to go back to the title screen before picking an opponent? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for what happens when the game over overlay is displayed — can the player interact with the board behind it? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the commentary persistence behavior specified — does commentary remain visible while the human takes their next turn, or does it clear? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements specified for the very first CPU move (after human's first move) — does the commentary area appear for the first time with an entry animation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 - Is the behavior defined when the backend returns a valid move but empty or missing commentary text? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the behavior defined when the game reaches a state where the CPU's only valid move is the winning move? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements specified for what happens if the CPU move response arrives after the user has already left the game screen (e.g., via "Play Again" during loading)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is the 5-second delay threshold (US4 acceptance scenario 3) documented as a requirement in the functional requirements section, or only in the user story? [Traceability, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are the pre-written fallback commentary text and its trigger conditions documented as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK035 - Are performance requirements limited to SC-005 (3-second response), or should additional targets be specified for page load time, animation frame rate, etc.? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the accessibility deferral (Assumption 9) clearly stated as out-of-scope rather than simply omitted? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 - Is the assumption "backend running locally" (Assumption 8) sufficient, or should requirements define behavior when the backend is at a remote URL? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the assumption about pre-written fallback quotes validated — are enough quotes specified to avoid repetition across multiple games? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 - Does the spec document the dependency on the existing backend scaffold (FastAPI + LangGraph) and its current state of completeness? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are the OpenAI model and API key requirements documented as prerequisites, or only implied through the backend? [Dependency, Gap]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Items are "unit tests for requirements" — they evaluate whether requirements are well-written, not whether implementation works
- Reference markers: `[Spec §X]` = references existing spec section, `[Gap]` = identifies missing requirement, `[Ambiguity]` = unclear language
- Focus areas: game mechanics, LLM integration, UI/UX flow, error handling
- Depth: Standard | Audience: Pre-implementation reviewer
